requestedOutcome: Let local Keel publish exact public-safe feature work as a deterministic pull-request handoff so platform Axiom/Mir can independently review and merge without spending local reasoning supply on merge transport.
cheapestHonestRoute: Compose the merged read-only checkpoint, existing publish-lane pre-push guard, host git, and host-authenticated GitHub CLI through one bounded adapter.

newHand.purpose: Push one exact clean feature branch and create or update one draft PR without merge authority.
side_effects: draft PR create or title/body update
newHand.resource_budget: One remote-ref query, one PR query, at most one branch push, one PR create or edit, and one receiver readback.
newHand.failure_and_recovery: Refuse before side effects when stale. If branch push succeeds but PR confirmation fails, preserve a typed partial receipt and never auto-delete or rewind remote state.
newHand.compatibility_version_contract: Consumes deterministic-pr-checkpoint v0.1 packets and GitHub CLI JSON fields; emits publisher v0.1 packets.
newHand.verification_contract: Pure deterministic plan tests, denied-boundary tests, mocked sender/receiver transport, real read-only GitHub plan, and one live self-publication receipt.
newHand.promotion_gate: Remain EXPERIMENTAL; technical merge does not change roots or CANON.
